honesty.container_vs_payload: container_sha256 is the .gz file; payload_sha256 is the decompressed NDJSON. Both are checked; neither stands in for the other.
honesty.index_presence_is_not_coverage: coverage requires type0 AND type7 to span the local window; a symbol merely listed in the index is not called covered.
honesty.no_candles_computed: this stage verifies bytes and counts only. No factor was written to any database, no candle was built, and neither red-line DB was opened.
honesty.recount_scope: the factor chain was recomputed for the frozen 30 only, not for all 759 symbols; the other 729 were compared on counts, windows, spellings and asset ids.
honesty.transfer_report_is_not_evidence: the owner's LFS-TRANSFER-VERIFICATION.json was not used as input. Every number here was re-derived from the bytes.

owner_source.read_method: git cat-file blob; no checkout, no working tree of the owner branch was created
